text:
amy (AE): Prospect: AtlasSavings wants a 2-week private POC. Must BYO KMS, preserve client src IP to their SIEM, block all outbound internet, and need a filled security questionnaire + network checklist by EOD. Also asked for Dedicated pricing for steady 100 rps.

leo (Solutions Eng): Two safe topologies: PrivateLink (interface endpoints per AZ) or VPC peering via transit. PrivateLink reduces route exposure; peering easier for high-throughput. Both can be locked down to deny 0.0.0.0/0.

rene (NetOps): Main blocker: SNAT from ALBs/load balancers. Confirm LB vendor/version. If SNAT unavoidable, we can tunnel logs (preserve original IP) back to their SIEM or use a hairpin NATless transit.

mina (Security): KMS: we support envelope encryption with customer KMS. Need ARN + cross-account role with kms:Decrypt/Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions. We'll provide policy templates. Note: runtime doesn't perform HSM attestation.

oscar (Infra): Egress options: 1) Route all egress to their proxy via IPsec, 2) Deny 0.0.0.0/0 and only allow our management CIDRs + their SIEM IPs, or 3) PrivateLink with a proxy in their VPC that forwards to SIEM. Also flag: OCSP/CRL lookups may need exceptions.

amy (AE): They want a pasteable firewall snippet and an IAM/KMS policy to include in their change request. Can we deliver in ~3 hours?

leo (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a 1-page checklist: VPCE SG rules, required management CIDRs, SNAT test steps, and KMS trust policy sample.

rene (NetOps): Quick firewall snippet to paste:
# Allow app subnets -> VPCE
ALLOW_SRC=10.30.0.0/16
VPCE=vpce-0a1b2c3d4e
iptables -A FORWARD -s $ALLOW_SRC -d $VPCE -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# Allow IPsec if using tunnel: UDP 500, UDP 4500

mina (Security): KMS trust example (short): { "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[{ "Effect":"Allow", "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodServiceRole"}, "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"] }]} -- we'll recommend scoping on Resource and Conditions for prod.

oscar (Infra): Latency note: Dedicated 4xA10G in eu-west typically hits p95 ~120-220ms for short completions at 100 rps with quantized model. Burst capacity to 300 requires prewarm/autoscale, recommend reserved + burst. Pricing DM to AE.

amy (AE): Great. I'll schedule the technical call for tomorrow 09:00 CET and attach checklist to RFP. ticket-bot: created ticket AS-591 for AtlasSavings POC.

rene (NetOps): Final reminder: verify LB SNAT behavior. If their LB does SNAT and they need TCP src IP, we must plan a tunnel to preserve it.

amy (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll post the questionnaire and KMS ARNs here when we get them.
